en.text: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

zhSimplified.text: 王带着哈曼来赴王后以斯帖的筵席。

zhTraditional.text: 王帶着哈曼來赴王后以斯帖的筵席。

en.text: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

zhSimplified.text: 这第二次在酒席筵前，王又问以斯帖说：「王后以斯帖啊，你要什么，我必赐给你；你求什么，就是国的一半也必为你成就。」

zhTraditional.text: 這第二次在酒席筵前，王又問以斯帖說：「王后以斯帖啊，你要甚麼，我必賜給你；你求甚麼，*就是國的一半也必為你成就。」

en.text: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

zhSimplified.text: 王后以斯帖回答说：「我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以为美，我所愿的，是愿王将我的性命赐给我；我所求的，是求王将我的本族赐给我。

zhTraditional.text: 王后以斯帖回答說：「我若在王眼前蒙恩，王若以為美，我所願的，是願王將我的性命賜給我；我所求的，是求王將我的本族賜給我。

en.text: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

zhSimplified.text: 因我和我的本族被卖了，要剪除杀戮灭绝我们。我们若被卖为奴为婢，我也闭口不言；但王的损失，敌人万不能补足。」

zhTraditional.text: 因我和我的本族被賣了，要剪除殺戮滅絕我們。我們若被賣為奴為婢，我也閉口不言；但王的損失，敵人萬不能補足。」

en.text: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈随鲁王问王后以斯帖说：「擅敢起意如此行的是谁？这人在哪里呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈隨魯王問王后以斯帖說：「擅敢起意如此行的是誰？這人在哪裏呢？」

en.text: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯帖说：「仇人敌人就是这恶人哈曼！」 哈曼在王和王后面前就甚惊惶。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯帖說：「仇人敵人就是這惡人哈曼！」 哈曼在王和王后面前就甚驚惶。

en.text: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

zhSimplified.text: 王便大怒，起来离开酒席往御园去了。哈曼见王定意要加罪与他，就起来，求王后以斯帖救命。

zhTraditional.text: 王便大怒，起來離開酒席往御園去了。哈曼見王定意要加罪與他，就起來，求王后以斯帖救命。

en.text: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

zhSimplified.text: 王从御园回到酒席之处，见哈曼伏在以斯帖所靠的榻上；王说：「他竟敢在宫内、在我面前凌辱王后吗？」这话一出王口，人就蒙了哈曼的脸。

zhTraditional.text: 王從御園回到酒席之處，見哈曼伏在以斯帖所靠的榻上；王說：「他竟敢在宮內、在我面前凌辱王后嗎？」這話一出王口，人就蒙了哈曼的臉。

en.text: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

footnotes.text: 7:9 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

zhSimplified.text: 伺候王的一个太监名叫哈波拿，说：「哈曼为那救王有功的末底改做了五丈高的木架，现今立在哈曼家里。」王说：「把哈曼挂在其上。」

zhTraditional.text: 伺候王的一個太監名叫哈波拿，說：「哈曼為那救王有功的末底改做了五丈高的木架，現今立在哈曼家裏。」王說：「把哈曼掛在其上。」

en.text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

zhSimplified.text: 于是人将哈曼挂在他为末底改所预备的木架上。王的忿怒这才止息。

zhTraditional.text: 於是人將哈曼掛在他為末底改所預備的木架上。王的忿怒這才止息。
